context_text:

Starter plan costs $15 per month and allows 3 chatbots and 500 documents. Pro plan costs $49 per month with 10 chatbots.
user_message: Starter plan ki price aur bot limit kya hai?
ground_truth_answer: Starter plan ki monthly price $15 hai aur is mein aap 3 chatbots bana sakte hain aur 500 documents upload kar sakte hain.

context_text:
[Source 1]
All database tables enforce PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) tied to org_id. Multi-tenant vector searches strictly filter by chatbot_id and org_id.
user_message: How do you prevent data leaks between different customer organizations?
ground_truth_answer: We enforce multi-tenant isolation using PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) tied to the organization ID, and vector searches strictly filter by chatbot ID and organization ID.
